Welcome to

Puzzle Path
Scavenger Hunts

Discover Queensland, one clue at a time

Start your Adventure “I can’t wait to try my first Puzzle Path — it looks like so much fun!” - Pauline Griffiths

How Puzzle Path Works

Pick from a range of exciting themed hunts — from romantic couples’ walking quests to teams driving challenges.

Select your preferred day and time, and secure your place in just a few clicks. No prep needed — just bring your sense of fun!

Meet at the start location, receive your first clue and set off on a real-world adventure through Queensland’s best-kept secrets.

Reach the finish line, snap some selfies, and bask in the glory — you’ve earned it! Join the leader board and share your story.

Start your Adventure “This is exactly what Queensland needs — a fun way to explore and challenge yourself!” - Robert Anderson

“Laughter. Clues. Adventure. That’s the Puzzle Path way — your new favourite way to discover Queensland!”

Welcome to

Puzzle Path

Scavenger Hunts

Discover the Gold Coast, one clue at a time

Start your Adventure “I can’t wait to try my first Puzzle Path — it looks like so much fun!” - Pauline Griffiths

How Puzzle Path Works

Pick from a range of exciting themed hunts — from romantic couples’ walking quests to teams driving challenges.

Select your preferred day and time, and secure your place in just a few clicks. No prep needed — just bring your sense of fun!

Meet at the start location, receive your first clue and set off on a real-world adventure through the Gold Coast’s best-kept secrets.

Reach the finish line, snap some selfies, and bask in the glory — you’ve earned it! Join the leader board and share your story.

Start your Adventure “This is exactly what the Gold Coast needs — a fun way to explore and challenge yourself!” - Robert Anderson

“Laughter. Clues. Adventure. That’s the Puzzle Path way — your new favourite way to discover the Gold Coast!”

Explore Queensland, your way

Live Adventures

Explore with a Puzzle Master and fellow adventurers. Solve clues together, discover local landmarks and share a few laughs along the way.

AT YOUR OWN PACE

Anytime Adventures

Choose a flexible, self-paced quest and follow the clues when it suits you. Discover parks, beaches, laneways and hidden gems along the way.

  • Explore independently with your crew
  • Choose a walking or driving quest
  • Great for couples, families, visitors and locals

SOLVE IT TOGETHER

Team & Group Quests

Bring everyone together for puzzles, teamwork and a little friendly competition. Collaborate or compete as you uncover each clue.

Ideal for corporate events, birthdays, hens and bucks celebrations, and school excursions.

LITTLE EXPLORERS WELCOME

Family & Kid-Friendly Quests

Enjoy imaginative adventures with easy clues, colourful maps and interactive surprises to keep younger explorers engaged.

Ideal for families with kids aged 5–12, school groups and parent-child adventures. Check each quest for suitability.

item.title: About Puzzle Path – Gold Coast Scavenger Hunts
item.dc:creator: andrew
item.ns2:encoded:
About Puzzle Path

What Is Puzzle Path?

Puzzle Path is an interactive scavenger hunt experience designed to help you explore the Gold Coast in the most exciting way possible—through puzzles, clues, and real-world discovery.
Whether you're a local looking for a fresh adventure or a tourist wanting to see the city from a new angle, our quests combine fun, challenge, and discovery in every step.

Our Mission: Adventure for Everyone

We believe adventure should be accessible to everyone. That’s why we design our quests to be inclusive, family-friendly, and flexible for all ages and abilities. Puzzle Path is here to bring people together through the power of play.

How Puzzle Path Works

  • Choose Your Quest - Browse themed adventures across the Gold Coast, from beaches to rainforests.
  • Follow the Clues - Each checkpoint reveals riddles and local trivia.
  • Uncover Secrets - Unlock local history, hidden gems, and fun surprises.

Born on the Gold Coast

Puzzle Path began with a single idea: to help someone experience joy through adventure.

The very first scavenger hunt was created by Andrew, the original creator and director of Puzzle Path, for a client living with a disability through the NDIS. They had such a great time exploring, solving clues, and sharing the experience, it sparked a bigger vision:

"What if everyone could access this kind of fun—personal, inclusive, and filled with discovery?"

That question became the heart of Puzzle Path.

It’s your turn to uncover the Gold Coast, one clue at a time.
Start Your Adventure

Puzzle Path began with a single idea: to help someone experience joy through adventure.

The very first scavenger hunt was created by Andrew, the original creator and director of Puzzle Path, for a client living with a disability through the NDIS. They had such a great time exploring, solving clues, and sharing the experience, it sparked a bigger vision:

"What if everyone could access this kind of fun—personal, inclusive, and filled with discovery?"

That question became the heart of Puzzle Path.
